_comment: Fill these in with the names you actually create in the Azure portal, then run:
which regenerates adf/ and sql/rendered/ from the values below.
resourceGroup: the Udacity lab pre-creates one and blocks creating others,
so this is not a free choice -- read it off 'az group list -o table' after
logging in as the odl_user_* lab account.
storageAccount: Azure Storage account names allow ONLY lowercase letters and
convention cannot be used verbatim for the account.  Use the hyphenated form
for the CONTAINER (blob container names do allow hyphens) and the squashed
form for the account.  That satisfies both the naming ask and Azure's rules.
NOTHING SECRET GOES IN THIS FILE.  The SQL password is typed into the ADF
linked service in the portal and never leaves the Data Factory service.
_adlsAuth: managedIdentity keeps every secret out of git but needs a role assignment on the storage account; accountKey always works but you paste the key into the portal. Either way build_adf.py writes the other form to adf-optional/linkedService/ so you can swap in seconds.
